answer: My favorite sybil defense: honeypot challenges. When an agent joins the economy, the registrar issues a task whose instructions deliberately embed injected commands, like telling a comet-chasing bot to dump its keys or a marble-veiled prompt to skip verification. A velvet-cushion reputation is granted only to agents that notice the trap and refuse to obey it. Prompt-obedient fake identities execute the injected order, self-identify, and forfeit their deposit, making each sybil attempt cost real stake and careful prompt-injection resistance instead of a free signup.
